title: Monotone-Constrained Diffusion Models for Long-Horizon Production Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2609.22643v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Forecasting a long horizon from only the first observations of a sequence is ill-posed: many trajectories are consistent with the same short history. We study this problem in oil and gas production forecasting, where forecasts made after roughly the first fifth of a well's producing life drive development and abandonment decisions, and where a usable forecast must describe a monotone decline. We present Physics-SIMS-TS, a conditional diffusion forecaster that combines negative guidance against synthetic artifacts, decline-curve constraints and an isotonic projection applied during sampling, spatial training augmentation, and an ensembled stochastic sampler yielding a full predictive distribution. translated_title: 面向长期生产预测的单调约束扩散模型
translated_abstract: 仅从序列的初始观测值预测长期走势是一个不适定问题：许多轨迹都与同一短暂的历史数据相一致。我们在油气产量预测中研究这一问题——在该领域中，油井生产寿命约前五分之一后做出的预测会驱动开发与废弃决策，且可用的预测必须描述单调递减的产量。我们提出 Physics-SIMS-TS，这是一种条件扩散预测器，它结合了针对合成伪影的负向引导、递减曲线约束以及采样过程中应用的保序投影、空间训练增强，以及能产生完整预测分布的集成随机采样器。在跨三个司法管辖区、超过35,000口油井的数据上，在共享空间、验证集冻结的协议下，Physics-SIMS-TS 是对比中最准确的扩散预测器，与集成 Transformer 相当具有竞争力，但并不优于后者。
tldr: 提出融合递减曲线物理约束、保序投影与负向引导的条件扩散模型 Physics-SIMS-TS，在超过35,000口油井的长期油气产量预测中成为最准确的扩散预测器。
en_tdlr: Physics-SIMS-TS, a conditional diffusion model combining decline-curve physics constraints, isotonic projection, and negative guidance, achieves the most accurate diffusion-based long-horizon oil and gas production forecasting across 35,000+ wells.
